name: What happens after a roof flashing leak assessment?

mainEntity.name: What happens after a roof flashing leak assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a roof flashing leak assessment, our technicians will provide a comprehensive report detailing the condition of your flashing, identifying any current leaks or potential weak points. This report will include photographs and a clear explanation of the findings. We will then present you with a detailed estimate for any necessary repairs or replacements, outlining the scope of work and material options. You'll have the information needed to make an informed decision about proceeding with repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: You'll receive a detailed report with findings, photos, and an estimate for any necessary flashing repairs or replacements, allowing you to make an informed decision.
